SET.summary: Sets a single session attribute to the given value.

arguments.name: reply_type
arguments.summary: Data interchange format for responses. Valid values: bson, json.

arguments.name: input_type
arguments.summary: Data interchange format for inputs. Valid values: bson, json.

arguments.name: batch
arguments.summary: Number of documents returned per batch. Must be greater than 0.

arguments.name: object_id_format
arguments.summary: Encoding of object id values in responses. Valid values: bytes, hex.

arguments.name: value
arguments.summary: The new value. Enum values are case-insensitive.
